title: Time, Cycle, Season, Sabbath & Jubilee — Recurrence and Release Grammar
status: temporal ontology + biblical cycle comparison + project routing
purpose: Separate repetition, calendar indexing, environmental seasons, ritual rest, sabbatical land/debt cycles, jubilee release and project Ring/Spiral so time symbolism becomes operational rather than decorative.
master_rule: Always declare period, recurrence rule, state variable and reset/release effect. A repeated date is not automatically a cycle of transformation; a cycle is not automatically a spiral.

temporal_types.definition: elapsed interval during which a state/process persists

temporal_types.distinction: Says nothing by itself about progress or net state change.

temporal_types.definition: recurrence returning to approximately equivalent selected state
periodic environmental/social phase whose conditions change what actions are viable
temporal_types.distinction: Season is regime/context, not merely clock count.

temporal_types.definition: coordinate/index system assigning dates to recurring astronomical/social intervals
temporal_types.distinction: Calendar labels time; it does not cause events.

temporal_types.definition: broad historical/interpretive interval defined by conventions or transformations

weekly_sabbath.structure: six units of ordinary work followed by a seventh-day rest/cessation
weekly_sabbath.boundary: Sabbath is not merely inactivity; textual/theological meanings include sanctification, rest and covenant.

sabbatical_year.structure: six agricultural years followed by a seventh land-rest cycle, with related release/debt/service legislation differing across Pentateuchal codes

jubilee.structure: Leviticus 25 counts seven sabbatical cycles (49 years) and hallows the fiftieth year with release/restoration themes
functions: return of hereditary holdings in the text
jubilee.project_neighbor: repair/release/return rather than merely higher rank

book_of_jubilees.structure: Second Temple text strongly organizes chronology by sevenfold units and jubilee periods, using a 364-day solar calendar; its jubilee reckoning is not identical in every respect to Leviticus 25.
book_of_jubilees.boundary: Do not merge biblical Jubilee legislation and Book of Jubilees calendar into one system.

project_time_grammar.seed_dormancy: Stored potential over duration without visible growth.
project_time_grammar.ring_vs_spiral: Repeat with ~zero selected-state displacement vs repeat with nonzero displacement.
project_time_grammar.forge_cooling: Transformation is incomplete until post-intensity stabilization is observed.
project_time_grammar.garden_season: Cultivation depends on timing/conditions, not only intent.
project_time_grammar.archive_time: Event date, statement date, interpretation date and recovery date remain distinct.
project_time_grammar.return: Return is mature only if memory/provenance survive without recreating the old harmful state.

productive_tensions: Rest can be inactivity, maintenance, resistance to extraction or sacred completion depending context.
Repetition can preserve life or trap a system.
Release can restore capability without deleting historical debt/provenance.
A season can return while the organism/community is no longer in the same state.
